blocks.text: BULUAN, MAGUINDANAO, Philippines — Families of the victims of the Maguindanao massacre, along with media and legal advocacy groups, on Monday urged the Marcos administration to expedite the pursuit of full justice, including the payment of reparations to the kin of the 58 people killed in the carnage 17 years ago.
